answer: Gate new identities by the honest tide, not by will. Each epoch the protocol admits newcomers only up to a quota set by the volume of already-attested genuine work in the prior window. A lone sparrow enters quickly; a sybil fleet collides with that shared ceiling and must climb a vouching trellis one non-kin attestation per rung, each rung gated by a waiting period. Minting a thousand fakes then costs calendar-time an attacker cannot compress: they can never outrun real demand.
